context: Hiroshi welcomes Ren back as a part-time intern.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: レン君、また、来てくれた。
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment on the name. Measured pace, steady composure. A note of genuine approval underneath the formality — not effusive, but real.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、よろしくお願いします。
lines.en: Yes. Thank you for having me.
lines.style: Respectful bow in the voice. Soft, earnest opening. No rush — each word carries intention. Slight breath before the gratitude, sincere without being stiff.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: I'm going to give you more responsibility.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact statement delivered with quiet authority. Brief pause after the first clause — this is significant and he knows Ren will understand. Not harsh, but unambiguous.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I'll do my best. With everything I have.
lines.style: Quick, bright commitment. No hesitation in the opening. The second clause lands with quiet intensity — genuine, not performative. A slight lift at the end, ready.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 会社、お前みたいな、人材、必要。
lines.en: The company needs people like you.
lines.style: Direct statement of fact, delivered without flattery. Weight on 'needs.' Steady eye-contact level throughout. This isn't praise — it's clarity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Soft landing. Genuine depth underneath the formality. A small breath before 'truly' — the word carries real feeling, not just politeness. Quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Warm close, almost gentle. The word 'together' lands as an invitation, not a command. A slight softening in the final clause — the formality eases just enough to let the connection show.
